t: A university FPGA trainer board packed with switches, lights, sensors, and ports.
steps: Buy the Nexys A7-100T from DigiKey or TestEquity for about 349 US dollars.
Get a micro USB cable to connect it to your computer.
Install AMD Vivado with its free edition, and set aside a few hours for the download.
Download the Nexys A7 master constraint file from Digilent's XDC repo.
Build a design that turns on an LED with a switch.
Load it onto the board from Vivado and flip the switch.
Try the seven segment display and the built-in sensors next.
meta: Open Board. From $249. A few stores.
